topic: 3. Other Eligibility Conditions In order to be eligible, the applicants must : - be a woman [1] ; - apply as a natural person [2] ; - be legally residing [3] in an EU Member State, including overseas countries and territories (OCTs) or a country associated to Horizon Europe [4] ; - be the founder or co-founder [5] of the company or organisation [6] ; - the company or organisation must be established in an EU Member State including overseas countries and territories, (OCTs) or a country associated to Horizon Europe [7] , and registered or incorporated [8] at least one year before the call year [9] ; - applicants who have already received an EU or Euratom prize cannot receive a second prize for the same activities. Applicants to the Rising Innovators category must be aged under 35 at the start of the call year [10] . Applicants to the EIT category must have a direct link to the EIT Community [11] . Applicants are expected to provide proof of eligibility upon request. Applicants eligible for several prize categories can only apply to one. In the case of applications submitted under multiple categories, only the latest application will be considered, and all other applications will be rejected as ineligible. Joint applications by a group of applicants are not accepted and will be rejected as ineligible. Applicants from the same organisation must apply separately.
